title: Printing comparison results
description: You can evaluate three Boolean expressions using the same age.

steps.description: You store 21 in age with one equals sign. The first comparison asks whether 21 is at least 18 and prints True.

steps.question: What does age >= 35 print?
steps.answer: It prints False because 21 is less than 35.

steps.description: The last expression uses == to compare age with 21. You check equality while keeping the stored age unchanged.
You see True, False and True on separate lines. Each print displays the Boolean value of one comparison.
